name: Jackson Boys
description: Chinese American street gang based in San Francisco's Chinatown, formed circa 1992 after a federal crackdown dismantled the Wo Hop To triad. Founded by three brothers — Bobby, Johnny, and Tommy Tsan — who were former Wah Ching members that had defected to the Wo Hop To before its collapse. Engaged in extortion, loansharking, drug trafficking, arson, and illegal gambling. Noted for a 1995 shooting on Stockton Street that wounded seven bystanders. Faced federal racketeering charges in the early 2000s and has maintained a presence in the Bay Area since.
